latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image Compressor Pro Online.

- Upload and compress images (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, up to 200MB) using cloud GPU processing.
- Simple workflow: upload images, specify compression goals (e.g., "compress to under 500KB"), and download optimized 1080p MP4 results.
- Automatic setup with support for anonymous sessions (no manual token required).
- Batch upload and processing for faster workflows.
- Multiple export formats supported: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Built-in credit management, error handling, and clear responses for common user actions.
